items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He actually organized this musical. It featured a bunch of us young musicians.

ctx.x: He actually organized this musical. It featured a bunch of us young musicians. We had singers. We had dancers. We had -- I wrote -- he wrote a script, and I wrote background music. What I am trying to say is there were people who loved the music and wanted to culturally expand the image beyond just playing --
